messages:
ada: Meet Nimbus 🪶 — my sugar glider in his hammock. He decided to yawn mid-zoom, so I caught the world’s tiniest roar. pic: https://files.redwood/sugarglider_nap.jpg

devin: no way. that yawn is peak content :heart_eyes: where did you get the hammock?

lina: also — legitimately obsessed. can they tolerate apartment noise? thinking about a tiny roommate. :eyes: 

ada: got the hammock from a small exotic-pet shop nearby. they’re actually super chill if handled right. noise-wise Nimbus sleeps through our blender at 7am so maybe? :sweat_smile: 

sam: must. have. more. pics. pls. 

ada: posted a short clip in #random — 5s loop. warning: contains Peak Adorbz. 

maria: PSA from experience — sugar gliders need a lot of attention and a special diet (nectar, insects, safe fruits). not a low-effort pet. also check local regs before getting one. :memo:

ops-bot: image uploaded: sugarglider_nap.jpg (size: 1.2MB)

devin: Aww, noted. thanks for the tip @maria. Ada, if Nimbus ever opens for hiring, I’ll apply to be a cuddle contractor. :raised_hands:

lina: can we add Nimbus to the next #pet-calendar? 1-month feature? :calendar: 

ada: yes! put him down as March mascot. also open to Nimbus-themed stickers if design wants inspo. :sticker-heart:

sam: vote: 1) Nimbus the Napper 2) Nimbus the Nibbler 3) Nimbus the Tiny Yawner

maria: 3, forever and always.

devin: 1 & 3 combo.

ada: consensus reached. Nimbus: Tiny Yawner & Nap Specialist. thanks y’all :blush:
